our_interpretation: We read 'three quarters' as the three calendar quarters after the post, ending 2024-12-31.
We read 'the biggest companies in tech' as including Microsoft and Alphabet (Google), which the same post names among the companies whose market value is tied to AI.
We read 'savaging the revenues' as a large fall in revenue against the same quarter a year earlier. We set no threshold, because revenue that grew contradicts any reading of 'savaging'.
criteria.support_condition: By the quarter ending 2024-12-31, the revenues of the biggest tech companies tied to AI had fallen sharply compared with a year earlier.
criteria.contradiction_condition: In the quarter ending 2024-12-31, the revenues of the biggest tech companies named in the post grew compared with the same quarter a year earlier.

payload.rationale: On March 18, 2024, Zitron wrote that AI had three quarters to prove itself before an 'apocalypse' that would savage the revenues of the biggest tech companies. In August 2024 he repeated the prediction and said he stood by it, while adding that it 'isn’t super useful to attach things to time.' This record tests the forecast with the three-quarter horizon he gave in March. In the quarter ending December 31, 2024, the last of the three, Microsoft's revenue rose 12% to $69.6 billion and Alphabet's rose 12% to $96.5 billion, each against the same quarter a year earlier. Their revenues grew, so the revenue element did not happen by the deadline.
limitations: Only the revenue element is assessed. 'The apocalypse' is figurative and is not tested.

In August 2024 Zitron said he stood by the prediction but that attaching it to a time was not useful. The three-quarter horizon tested here is the one he stated in March 2024. His August remark sets no new deadline, so it is not tested separately.
The packet covers two of the companies named in the post. Amazon's release could not be read.
The figures are the companies' own unaudited quarterly disclosures.

evidence.excerpt: results for the quarter ended December 31, 2024, as compared to the corresponding period of last fiscal year: · Revenue was $69.6 billion and increased 12%
evidence.explanation: Microsoft's revenue for the quarter ended December 31, 2024, the last quarter of the horizon, was $69.6 billion, up 12% from a year earlier. A rise is not a savaging.

evidence.excerpt: Consolidated Alphabet revenues in Q4 2024 increased 12% year over year to $96.5 billion
evidence.explanation: Alphabet's revenue for the fourth quarter of 2024 was $96.5 billion, up 12% from a year earlier.

evidence.excerpt: While I certainly goofed claiming generative AI had three quarters left in March 2024
evidence.explanation: Zitron's own later comment on this forecast. It shows how he reads his own statement. It does not decide the outcome.
